steps.text: Each player: 12 minions and 6 buildings of one colour; a Player Aid card
Each player puts 1 minion in The Shades, The Scours and Dolly Sisters; 1 trouble marker in each of those 3 areas
Other trouble markers, demons and trolls beside the board; the money as the bank
Each player takes $10 (money is always open)
2 players: remove Chrysoprase from the Personalities and Hubert and Cosmos Lavish from the brown deck
Shuffle the Personality cards; deal 1 secretly to each player; set the rest aside unseen
Shuffle the Random Event cards facedown beside the board
Shuffle the brown Player cards; shuffle the green ones and put them on top
Deal 5 cards each; the rest is the draw pile
City Area cards faceup beside the board
Lord Vetinari
details: Spies: start your turn with minions in 11 / 10 / 9 different demon-free areas (2 / 3 / 4 players)

steps.text: Lord Selachii, Lord Rust, Lord de Worde
details: Control: start your turn controlling 7 / 5 / 4 areas (2 / 3 / 4 players); control means more pieces than any other player and than the trolls there, and no demon

steps.text: Dragon King of Arms
details: Chaos: start your turn with 8 trouble markers on the board

steps.text: Chrysoprase
details: Wealth: start your turn worth $50 or more (cash plus your buildings' costs, each loan counts -$12)

steps.text: Commander Vimes
details: Patience: you win if nobody else has won when the draw pile runs out

steps.text: End of turn: draw back up to 5 cards (no discarding if you have more)
A Random Event symbol must be resolved; every other symbol is optional, left to right
A minion entering an area with other minions adds a trouble marker if there is none
If the deck runs out without Vimes: minion 5, building = its cost, $1 = 1 point
Roll the die to pick the first player
